scholar_cbop: Cash-Based Operating Profitability tilt on value_sn (80/20 fixed)
scholar_sue_usd: USD-deflated Standardized Unexpected Earnings tilt on value_sn (80/20 fixed)
scholar_real_cbop_sue: Inflation-consistent CbOP + USD SUE 3-pillar tilt on value_sn (75/15/10 fixed)
miner_ocf_ev_real: Real Enterprise Cash-Based Operating Yield tilt on value_sn (80/20 fixed)
miner_qgp_surp_real: Real Quarterly Gross Profit Surprise Yield tilt on value_sn (75/25 fixed)
miner_gp_qop_real: Gross Profit Yield + Real Operating Profit Surprise Yield tilt on value_sn (70/15/15 fixed)
risk_score_rank: Rank-linear score weighting within value_sn top-20%
risk_score_exp_cap: Exponential score weighting within value_sn top-20% with 5% name cap & 20% sector cap
risk_invvol: PIT 6m trailing inverse-volatility weighting within value_sn top-20%
risk_smooth_k3: 3-month staggered cohort smoothing of R0 equal-weight top-20%
risk_invvol_smooth_k3: 3-month staggered cohort smoothing of PIT 6m inverse-vol top-20%
risk_sector_ew: Sector-equalized weighting within value_sn top-20% with 5% name & 20% sector caps
risk_sn_invvol: Sector-neutral PIT 6m inverse-volatility weighting within value_sn top-20%
risk_max_div: PIT 6m Ledoit-Wolf Maximum Diversification weighting within value_sn top-20% (5% name & 20% sector caps)
ml_hgb: expanding-window walk-forward HistGradientBoosting rank-return predictor (2016-01+, PIT value/size/liq/mom/vol/sector features)
ml_hgb_blend50: 50/50 cross-sectional percentile-rank average of walk-forward ml_hgb and value_sn_z (2016-01+)
vlab_rev_ev (batch batch1): R0 4-leg value with S/P replaced by Rev/EV (EV as in ey leg)
vlab_gp_ev (batch batch1): R0 4-leg value with S/P replaced by GrossProfit/EV
vlab_op_mcap (batch batch1): R0 4-leg value with E/P replaced by TTM operating profit / mcap
vlab_ep_floor0 (batch batch1): R0 4-leg value with E/P floored at 0 before winsorize_z
vlab_val_mom15 (batch batch1): 0.85*value_sn_z + 0.15*sector-neutral mom_12_1_z (NaN->0)
mc_v1_min2 (batch metric_count): R0 score, only stocks with >= 2 valid value legs
mc_v2_min3 (batch metric_count): R0 score, only stocks with >= 3 valid value legs
mc_v3_all4 (batch metric_count): R0 score, only stocks with all 4 valid value legs
